args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was deployed and began failing health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an error rate of 18%. In response, checkout-api was rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent release known to be healthy in production. The rollback completed across all regions and the service is now healthy, with error rate back down to 0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still under investigation; v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until identified and fixed.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosed the failure:** checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), failing health checks with an 18% error rate.

- **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy in all regions on v2.3.0, with error rate back to 0.2%.
- **Opened incident INC-0001 (SEV2)** for checkout-api describing the v2.3.1 failure, the mitigating rollback, and the current healthy state. The on-call engineer has been paged. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure still needs investigation.
